tools.name: speak_text
tools.description: Convert text to speech audio using the configured TTS provider. Saves the audio file into the workspace and returns its path; deliver it to the user by embedding the path in your reply as [listen](vellum://workspace/<path>).

text.description: The text to synthesize into speech

voice_id.description: Optional provider-specific voice identifier override (e.g. an ElevenLabs voice ID). Omit to use the configured default voice.
